name: Not Operating
description: A mine has been operating and then closed or suspended

name: Abandoned
description: A mine is abandoned - one reason or another

name: Care and Maintenance
description: A mine is under care and maintenance

name: Closed
description: A mine can be closed for several reasons, e.g. technical, economical or technico-economical. For example, it may be re-opened if the price of the exploited commodity increases.

name: Historic
description: An 'old' mine which has been exploited before 1900, e.g. during Roman times, the Middle Ages, etc.

name: Retention
description: A mine can be kept unexploited until the price of contained commodity(ies) makes it economical.

name: Under Development
description: A mine is under development - e.g feasibilty

name: Construction
description: A mine is under construction after obtaining licenses/permits

name: Feasibility
description: Technical economic study aimed at assessing the possibility to launching a mine venture.

name: Pending Approval
description: Waiting for the exploitation authorization, generally given by a State Mining Engineering Department.

name: No Development
description: No development activity or feasibility study has been conducted for a prospect
